title: A budget can overshoot by a full poll interval because detectTrip only runs on observation
description:
Measured on run_62c289d1: RUN_MAX_COST_USD = 5 was deployed, syncRunCost recorded 5.86 correctly (so this is not the cts pagination defect), and the run was still in state running with no trip. The cause is cadence, not accounting: detectTrip is only called from observe, and pollDelay backs off from 15s to a 300s ceiling, so a run can spend for up to five minutes after crossing its ceiling. The backoff widens the window exactly when a run is long-lived and expensive, which is when it matters.

Options worth weighing rather than assuming: cap the poll interval while spend is within some fraction of the ceiling; check spend on a separate fixed cadence from the liveness observation; or have the gateway itself refuse once the ceiling is crossed, which needs no Workflow tick at all and is the only one that bounds the overshoot by a request rather than by a timer.
